Composites — tier-C GUI pass

Date: 2026-09-18 · Branch: fem-unified (520757f0c4 + capture fixes) · Captures: Coin-native renderer, viewport resolution, per-example camera angles (1.5 MB embedded)

Verdict

Every example loads and recomputes with no exceptions and no Invalid features — all registry examples (including the new per-variant stiffener and mould-demo IDs) build clean, 0 errors.

Capture method

The interactive GLSL weave shader does not survive offscreen capture faithfully, so these screenshots use the new Coin-native capture mode (features/CoinWeaveCapture.py): the weave shader is detached and each shell renders through plain Coin3D — an opaque light cloth texture with a dark warp/weft grid, mapped by the surface's UV coordinates, with a texture matrix carrying the layer's fibre angle and grid spacing (mirroring the shader uniforms). Rosettes, cut edges and native geometry are Coin-native already; the viewer theme and background are untouched. The interactive shader path remains the GUI renderer — capture mode is enter/exit per shell.

Camera: the tall curved panels (cylindrical/conical segments) are nearly edge-on at the default isometric angle, so each example is viewed from a per-example azimuth/elevation chosen to face the panel (camera transition polled to convergence before capture).

Scope & criteria

Success criteria (handoff §7, both required):

  1. Every example runs without errors — no exception in the report view or /tmp/freecad.log, no Invalid feature. Met (each capture reports invalid=none).
  2. The result is visually confirmed by the user — pending: your sign-off on the images above.

Known failure, not re-tested here: closed_ring_composite_shell — web drape coverage ~0.26 on the self-closing non-periodic B-spline web faces (nextdrape-internal; repro committed as inspect_ring_stiffener_web.py).

Examples whose geometry changed since the last GUI pass and therefore warrant extra attention: quasi_iso_stiffener_panel (plate enlarged to 180×120; both remainder faces now draped) and stiffener_composite_shell (foot rosettes should read parallel to the panel warp — the mirror fix).
